REASON: The reviewer identifies the risk of a 100% miss rate due to an empty cache from a failed warm-up script, but completely misses the planted fatal flaw: the uniform TTL causing all entries to expire simultaneously at 09:30 (a cache stampede). The recommendation is to revise and resubmit, not to abandon the proposal entirely.
